As a RF / Microwave Engineer you will bring deep signal-integrity and high-frequency design expertise into our Product Development team. You will own the microwave performance of our products from concept through validation, combining simulation, measurement and product development.

RF Design & Simulation - Perform 3D EM simulations of next-generation interconnects and transitions - Design microwave filters and attenuators - Perform microwave budget and cascade analysis - Validate simulations against measurements - Shape RF architecture of next-generation products 
Technical Ownership & Collaboration - Review third-party simulation models and measurement data - Support customer projects with RF expertise - Actively collect, analyze and translate feedback from customers, partners and suppliers, inside and outside of Europe - Define product roadmaps and specifications - Contribute to product documentation - Cross-functional collaboration 
What you bring - 5-10 years of working experience of which at least 4+ years working as RF / microwave expert - Knowledge of transmission lines, S-parameters, matching, filters and attenuators - Experience with HFSS, CST or similar 3D EM tools - Experience correlating simulations with RF measurements - Collaborative mindset and good English

You will work with Azure, Kubernetes/OpenShift, PostgreSQL and CI/CD while collaborating with data scientists, product owners and other engineers to deliver reliable production-grade solutions. About the company 
The organization is a large, innovative and internationally connected company focused on creating safe, sustainable and high-quality experiences. With around 3,000 employees, it combines technology, data and operational excellence to continuously improve its services and contribute to society and the wider economy. About you - Strong experience with Python backend development and REST APIs - Experience with Kubernetes and/or OpenShift - Strong knowledge of PostgreSQL and SQL - Experience with Microsoft Azure, including Azure Database for PostgreSQL - Experience deploying and operating applications in production environments - Experience with monitoring, troubleshooting and incident resolution - Experience building data-intensive platforms and externally consumed APIs - Experience with CI/CD and Git-based development workflows - Excellent communication skills in both English and Dutch - Bachelor-level education or equivalent professional experience 
 Offer 
The position offers a 32-hour working week from 1 October 2026 to 31 March 2027, with the possibility of working at the office on Tuesdays. The role falls under salary scale 13 of the applicable collective labour agreement.
